Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch or monetization decision. Compliance is technical-only: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown. Do not infer legal clearance from incomplete telemetry. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 as unattributed; do not infer site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, forecast, or causal lift. Continue only existing evidence, repair-or-close, measurement, parked-site, and attribution reconciliation work.

No task is closable because rights, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, and incident procedures remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence. Do not change production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, launch state, or send outreach.

GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; capture deployed consent, withdrawal, GA4 configuration, data-sharing, retention, and jurisdiction evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed; produce a read-only log, vendor, retention, access, incident, and request-procedure inventory.

Retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com as parked and private. Their latest compliance checks were unreachable, and launch evidence for reachability, disclosures, consent, analytics, monetization, and operational health is incomplete. Do not infer regulated, age-sensitive, adult, or NSFW status from domain names. Next evidence action: attach dated execution-owner verification, reachability, disclosure, consent, analytics, terms, monetization, and explicit launch-decision evidence while preserving parked/private status.
